title: Godot Crashing Issue when Opening a Project for Editing Purposes
body:
### Tested versions

- Issue was found in Godot 4.4.1(v4.4.1.stable.official [49a5bc7b6]) and Godot 4.2.2 (v4.2.2.stable.official [15073afe3])

### System information

Processor: Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-8750H CPU @ 2.20GHz   2.20 GHz 
Installed RAM: 16.0 GB (15.8 GB usable)
System type: 64-bit operating system, x64-based processor
Edition: Windows 11 Home
Version: 23H2
OS build: 22631.5262
Experience: Windows Feature Experience Pack 1000.22700.1081.0


### Issue description

- Issue:
-- When a project in the project manager is clicked, the editor window opens up but has a grey background and closes down after some loading time. The loading time got longer with the newer version

- Expected Output:
-- The project editor window should be display

- Side Note:
-- I found a similar issue from an older version of Godot and have attempted the fixes suggested by that post, but none have worked so far

- Link to similar past issues:
-- https://forum.godotengine.org/t/godot-crashes-when-trying-to-open-any-project-no-errors/62832
-- https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/41639#issuecomment-683813149

### Steps to reproduce

1. Open Godot
2. Clicked on any project
3. Issue arises
